# has score anchor

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasScoreAnchor`](gmeow-hasScoreAnchor.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasScoreAnchor>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/norms`](../../slices/norms.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a criterion to one of its calibration anchors. NOT functional: high / medium / low anchors coexist.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Criterion`](../classes/gmeow-Criterion.md) -> [`gmeow:ScoreAnchor`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreAnchor.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasScoreAnchor`](gmeow-hasScoreAnchor.md) from [`gmeow:Criterion`](../classes/gmeow-Criterion.md) to [`gmeow:ScoreAnchor`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreAnchor.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Criterion`](../classes/gmeow-Criterion.md), [`gmeow:ScoreAnchor`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreAnchor.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attach a calibration anchor to a criterion — high, medium, and low anchors coexist on one axis.

### Avoid when

- Avoid forcing a single anchor (it is non-functional) and avoid using it outside a criterion.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:hasScoreAnchor`](gmeow-hasScoreAnchor.md) from the [`gmeow:Criterion`](../classes/gmeow-Criterion.md) to each [`gmeow:ScoreAnchor`](../classes/gmeow-ScoreAnchor.md); several anchors calibrate one axis.
